name: Clément Lesaege
description: Clément is a computer scientist and founder of Kleros, a decentralized arbitration protocol for smart contracts. His work spans mechanism design, game theory, smart contract security, and decentralized coordination. Beyond Kleros, he has worked on Sybil-resistant systems like Proof of Humanity and on prediction and decision markets through Seer. He is interested in markets for governance, funding, risk, and collective decision-making. Outside work, Clément plays competitive Magic: The Gathering.
